overview: File allocation (contiguous, linked, indexed), Unix inode, directory implementation, file size limits.
coreConcept: Allocation method decide karta hai fragmentation, random access speed aur max file size.
hinglishExplanation: Contiguous: fast access par external fragmentation. Linked: no external fragmentation, sequential access, pointer overhead. Indexed / inode: random access, max size pointers ke count par depend karta hai.
formalDefinition: Allocation method decide karta hai fragmentation, random access speed aur max file size.
importantProperties: Contiguous: external fragmentation, fast random access.
Linked: no external fragmentation, slow direct access.
Indexed: no external fragmentation, random access; max size depends on block size aur address size.
Unix inode: direct + single + double + triple indirect.
Max file size = (direct + P + P^2 + P^3) x block size, P = block size / address size.
standardTechniques: P nikalo, phir levels add karo.
